metadata.description:
Brookings Country Club, recognized as one of the region's best golf courses, invites you to look through our web site and enjoy. We believe that once you join the Brookings Country Club, you will be a member for life.
Brookings Country Club offers golfing at its best and more. The 18 hole course is lush and challenging, the layout serene and the course uncrowded. From beautiful tee boxes to manicured greens, you will see why Tedd Evans has been recognized by his peers as South Dakota's Outstanding Golf Superintendent.
Following golf, enjoy the new restaurant and lounge overlooking the 18th green and Lake Campbell.

metadata.description: Rolling fairways, dramatic elevation changes, links-style bunkers and USGA specification greens characterize the 7,000-yd, par-72 championship golf course at the Golf Club at Red Rock in Rapid City, South Dakota. With a minimum of four tee placements per hole, players of all levels can enjoy a challenging and exhilarating world-class golf experience at the Golf Club at Red Rock. Embedded in the Black Hills terrain, the course features lush fairways, surrounded by native fescue grasses and tall ponderosa pine trees.

metadata.description: Willow Run Golf Course is a daily fee course. The 6,500 yard, par 71 layout rambles through the countryside just east of Sioux Falls, SD. Rated 4 stars by GOLF DIGEST, Willow Run offers a scenic challenge for golfers of all levels. Experience 18 holes of excitement at the most unique golf course in the area. Willow Run is open to the public, welcomes group outings, invites practice with its excellent driving range and full service pro-shop.  Willow Run is 18 holes of championship golf sure to satisfy any golfer!
